items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Burney Bigard [INTERVIEWEE] -- Barnaby Guard, and all of them, they still play Albert.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. We was playing band systems. I started out on Albert, though, you know. But -- in high school, the high school days. I played Albert. And, then, of course, when Boehm became popular, you know, and -- and everybody jumped to Boehm. But, all of the old masters like Buster Bailey and --
